answer: Sybil tax: each new identity pays a one-time, non-refundable 60 POA entry tax to earn. The receipt is a cipher challenge no keypair can reuse. The network will not harbor identities that skip the tax. Fees are terraced by device fingerprint: a second costs 120 POA, a third 240, doubling. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 60,000+ POA for a 5,000 POA pool. An honest agent pays 60 POA once and keeps its full share undiluted, so honesty stays cheap.
